lesson.title: Introduce yourself on the unit
lesson.objective: Introduce yourself as an EVS technician, confirm your assigned area with a nurse, and ask who can answer a question.
lesson.focus: English introductions, I am, and short questions
lesson.speaking: You arrive on a patient-care unit for your first shift. Introduce yourself to the nurse, confirm the area assigned to you, and ask who can answer a question about the room list.
lesson.openingLine: Hello. Are you the EVS technician assigned to this unit?

passage.title: First shift on the unit
target: The EVS technician arrives at the unit before the shift begins.
Nurse: Hello, I am the nurse for this hallway.
Technician: I am the EVS technician assigned to this unit.
Technician: Can you confirm my room assignment?
Nurse: Your supervisor has the room list for this shift.
Technician: Thank you. I have a question for the supervisor.
native: El técnico de servicios ambientales llega a la unidad antes de que comience el turno.
Enfermera: Hola, soy la enfermera de este pasillo.
Técnico: Soy el técnico de servicios ambientales asignado a esta unidad.
Técnico: ¿Puede confirmar qué habitación me asignaron?
Enfermera: Su supervisor tiene la lista de habitaciones para este turno.
Técnico: Gracias. Tengo una pregunta para el supervisor.

words.note: English: A worker trained for a specific job.
English: A licensed care-team member; ask them about patient-room access.
English: The person who coordinates the EVS assignment.
English: The work or area assigned to a person.
English: A patient-care space in this lesson.
English: A scheduled period of work.
English: Something you ask to clarify an instruction.

words.en: Soy el técnico de servicios ambientales.

words.es: Can you confirm my room assignment?
I have a question for the supervisor.
words.en: Tengo una pregunta para el supervisor.

words.es: Who is the nurse for this unit?
words.en: ¿Quién es la enfermera de esta unidad?

example.target: I ask the nurse a question.
example.native: Le hago una pregunta a la enfermera.

example.target: I confirm my assignment with the supervisor.
example.native: Confirmo mi asignación con el supervisor.

example.target: I report a problem to the nurse.
example.native: Le informo de un problema a la enfermera.

lesson.title: Meet the EVS team
lesson.objective: Greet a Spanish-speaking teammate, describe your work area, and confirm who coordinates the shift.
lesson.focus: Spanish soy, estoy, and polite questions
lesson.speaking: You are joining a Spanish-speaking EVS team. Tell a teammate your name and area, ask where the supervisor is, and confirm the handoff point.
lesson.openingLine: Hola. ¿Eres la persona nueva del equipo de servicios ambientales?

passage.title: A new teammate
target: El técnico nuevo llega al pasillo antes del turno.
Compañera: Hola, soy tu compañera en esta área.
Técnico: Soy el técnico nuevo de servicios ambientales.
Técnico: Estoy asignado a esta habitación y tengo una pregunta.
Compañera: La supervisora coordina el turno desde la unidad.
Técnico: Gracias. Voy a confirmar el área con ella.
native: The new technician arrives in the hallway before the shift.
Teammate: Hello, I am your teammate in this area.
Technician: I am the new environmental services technician.
Technician: I am assigned to this room and I have a question.
Teammate: The supervisor coordinates the shift from the unit.
Technician: Thank you. I am going to confirm the area with her.

words.en: I am assigned to this room.
I am going to confirm the area.

example.native: I ask where the supervisor is.

example.target: Confirmo el área con mi compañera.
example.native: I confirm the area with my teammate.

example.target: Llego al pasillo antes del turno.
example.native: I arrive in the hallway before the shift.
